resolution.plan: AIT-QA is listed as a 0.1K/0.3K split of the 515-question release (Table 5) with no example in Appendix F, and A.5 says formats follow Zhang et al. (2024a) or Xie et al. (2022), neither of which covers AIT-QA; the exact test split and AIT serialization therefore live in the TAMA repository. Pull both, run gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at temperature 0, and compute exact-match accuracy; compare with 88.57 (Table 6).
